data.narrative:
Dhruva Space is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised ₹27 crore to date. Valuation analysis relies on a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Varda Space Industries, spanning Series B through Series C funding stages.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the ₹27 crore raised proxy, yielding $51 million. Peer-Median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies produces a median valuation of $1.5 billion, with a range of $1.1 billion (Skyryse) to $8.0 billion (Sierra Space). Public-Comp Anchoring is not applicable because Dhruva Space's revenue is not on file; the sector median P/S of 26.4x across public peers cannot be deployed without this input.

The triangulated valuation range is $44 million (low) to $1.7 billion (high), with a median of $750 million. The wide dispersion reflects substantial stage heterogeneity within the peer set—three peers operate at Series C versus two at Series B—and the outsized influence of Sierra Space at $8.0 billion. Key uncertainties include Dhruva Space's revenue trajectory, capital intensity relative to peers, and whether the company's technology differentiation justifies positioning toward the upper or lower end of the peer distribution.
